start.title: [TODO:it] The Road from Beersheba
start.text:
[TODO:it] You are Jacob, fleeing Esau's wrath.
The sun lowers. Haran is far. Night is near.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Keep walking — find a place to rest
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You walk on. The wind cools. The hills stretch wide.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Turn back — beg Esau's mercy
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fear pulls you home. But the path back is closed.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Hide in the rocks until dark
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Hiding is not your road. Father said: go.

turn_back_consequence.title: [TODO:it] No Way Back
turn_back_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Esau's anger still burns. Your mother's voice returns:
"Flee to Haran. Stay until his fury cools."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Turn east again — keep walking
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You set your face toward Haran once more.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] The Rocks Are Cold
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Hidden, you wait. But hiding is not the calling.
The stars rise. The road still waits.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Step out and walk on
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You leave the shadows. The journey is yours.

wilderness.title: [TODO:it] Open Wilderness
wilderness.text:
[TODO:it] Hills stretch in every direction. Light is failing.
You must stop somewhere — soon.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Rest at this stony place
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Something quiet here. You step off the path.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Push on through the night
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Darkness swallows the road. You stumble blind.

push_on_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Lost in the Dark
push_on_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The path vanishes under your feet.
You turn back to the stones you passed.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stop and rest at the stony place
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The Lord's place was waiting all along.

the_place.title: [TODO:it] A Certain Place
the_place.text:
[TODO:it] Bare ground. Scattered stones. The sun is gone.
You have nothing for a pillow.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take a stone for a pillow
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You choose a smooth stone. It is enough.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Use your cloak — stones are too hard
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You shiver. The wind cuts through. Sleep won't come.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk on — find a softer spot
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Each spot is the same. The night is not for searching.

soft_consequence.title: [TODO:it] The Wind Won't Let You
soft_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The cold is sharper without a pillow.
A stone lies near your hand.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Place a stone beneath your head
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Hardness becomes rest. You close your eyes.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:it] All Ground Is the Same
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] You return to the first stones. Every place is
the same in the dark. This place will do.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Take a stone for a pillow
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You set a stone for your head and lie down.

lay_down.title: [TODO:it] Sleep Comes
lay_down.text:
[TODO:it] The stone is cold beneath your cheek.
The sky deepens. Your breathing slows.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Close your eyes and sleep
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Sleep takes you. And then — light.

the_dream.title: [TODO:it] A Stairway
the_dream.text:
[TODO:it] A great stairway rises from earth to heaven.
Angels of God ascend and descend on it.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Watch in silent awe
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You do not move. The light pours down.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Try to climb the stairway
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your foot will not lift. This is not for climbing — for seeing.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Call out to the angels
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your voice is small. They pass without turning.

climb_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not by Climbing
climb_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The stair is not yours to ascend.
A voice stirs above. You must only listen.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stand still and watch
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You bow your head. Light fills your eyes.

call_consequence.title: [TODO:it] They Do Not Answer
call_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The angels pass on their errand.
A greater Voice waits at the top of the stair.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Be silent and listen
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You fall quiet. Then He speaks.

the_voice.title: [TODO:it] The Voice Above
the_voice.text:
[TODO:it] "I am the LORD, God of Abraham and Isaac.
The land where you lie I will give to you."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Receive the promise in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You let the words enter you. Earth and heaven hold still.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Bargain — ask for proof first
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The promise is freely given. It needs no haggling.

bargain_consequence.title: [TODO:it] No Need to Bargain
bargain_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His word is sure. The Voice speaks again,
gentle: "I am with you. I will keep you."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Receive the promise
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your heart bows. The promise rests upon you.

the_promise.title: [TODO:it] "I Am With You"
the_promise.text:
[TODO:it] "I am with you. I will keep you wherever you go,
and bring you back to this land."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Treasure His words in your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] The vision fades. The stars return. Dawn is near.

awakening.title: [TODO:it] Surely the LORD Is Here
awakening.text:
[TODO:it] You wake trembling. "Surely the LORD is in this place,
and I did not know it."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Call this place the house of God
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] "This is none other than Bethel — the gate of heaven."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Hurry away before the vision returns
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Fear is not faith. The place asks something of you.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Tell no one — keep it secret
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Some things are sealed by remembrance, not silence.

flee_consequence.title: [TODO:it] The Place Holds You
flee_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] You take a few steps — and stop.
The stone where you slept must not be left bare.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Return and set up the stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You walk back. The stone is waiting.

secret_consequence.title: [TODO:it] A Mark Must Be Made
secret_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Silence is not enough. Generations must know
what the LORD did at this place.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Set up the stone as a pillar
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You lift the stone. It will stand as witness.

set_pillar.title: [TODO:it] The Stone Pillar
set_pillar.text:
[TODO:it] You take the stone from beneath your head
and set it upright. Dawn breaks soft and pink.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Pour oil on it as an offering
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Oil runs down the stone. It glistens in the morning light.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Leave it plain — it is enough
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Something more is owed. The Lord met you here.

plain_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Honor It Fully
plain_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] A bare stone is not yet an altar.
You have a small flask of oil at your side.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Anoint the stone with oil
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You pour the oil. It is the Lord's portion.

anoint.title: [TODO:it] Bethel — House of God
anoint.text:
[TODO:it] "This place shall be called Bethel.
The LORD shall be my God."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Vow a tenth of all He gives you
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] "Of all You give me, I will surely give a tenth to You."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Promise nothing — just receive
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Grace welcomes a vow in return. Words become a covenant.

withhold_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Make a Vow
withhold_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Your heart is full. A pledge rises in you —
a portion returned for a promise received.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Vow a tenth of all to the LORD
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] "Of all You give me, I will give a tenth to You."

the_vow.title: [TODO:it] The Road East
the_vow.text:
[TODO:it] You take up your staff. The morning is wide.
Haran lies far ahead — but you are not alone.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Walk on with the LORD
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Each step is lighter than the last. The promise walks with you.

journey_on.title: [TODO:it] The Promise Goes With You
journey_on.text:
[TODO:it] Bethel falls behind. The east opens before you.
You are kept. You are sent. You are seen.
